label: extension

args.subject: Group booking enquiry – 10 guests in June
args.body:
Hello,

I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to ask about availability for 10 people in June.

Could you please let me know which dates in June are available for a group of this size, along with the group rates and booking terms?

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text:
I emailed groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp, the group-bookings address from one of the City Hub reviews. The email asks which June dates are available for 10 people, and what the group rates and booking terms are.

I didn't give specific dates, since you only said "June". Once they reply, I can help with the next steps.
